content: Ray Aswarus nor rewre'wa Mordekhai tulu-petna la' geni-tienni

Ray Aswerus nhopan pa limni-rorni honona rpairi blastena, de edonna ntot nan to'a riy maka kholi-kletla la noha gaini, mere nawniatniat momuoga leta-ruhuna honona, makden la enhu'ula-ga' laini, pa nwewar la'a makden la wo'ora-kawru.

Ne rhorat targa la lodna-hairi Persia rora Media pukni ralamni la'a hare honona maka ray de nhi' nana de nodia preheni-mkaini inponni. Me rhorat tar wual momuoga la'a Mordekhai nla'a o'ta-mata tutulu-pepetna la lodna-hair die, onnila ray Aswerus nran e'a.

Mordekhai riy Yahudi miaka ha rrana pa ktorna-krauti olek de, eneknek to'ama natlin la ray Aswerus. E' de genni-tienni nareh dioin makden Yahudi re honona. Mere makden Yahudi re ratu rhu'ru-rhelam nohor la Mordekhai yoma honona ralamni rapliorlior la' nohwalli de. Yoma Mordekhai die nkar toto' meman pa namkek la'a e nohwalli honona re mormiorni-dardiarni totpena rler la kalwiedni-paitiotni.
